gradients/batch_1.sbatch.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=extra_gradients
#SBATCH --time=00:05:00
#SBATCH --array=0-5%1
#SBATCH --partition=hpxg
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%A_%a.out
set -euo pipefail
cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
# A prepared HOLD package must fail before any computation even if submitted manually.
grep -q '"submission_gate": "OPEN"' manifest.json
sha256sum -c PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS
test "${SLURM_NTASKS}" = 4
task=$(sed -n "$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID + 1))p" batch_1.txt)
test -n "$task"
module load openmpi/5.0
source "$HOME/project/soft/orca/env.sh"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$task"
sha256sum -c inputs.sha256
mkdir -p attempts
run_dir="attempts/${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}_${SLURM_RESTART_COUNT:-0}"
mkdir "$run_dir"
cp geom.xyz job.inp "$run_dir/"
cd "$run_dir"
mkdir mpi_tmp
export TMPDIR="$PWD/mpi_tmp"
export PRTE_MCA_prte_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR" PMIX_MCA_pmix_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR"
"$ORCA_DIR/orca" job.inp > job.log 2> job.stderr
grep -q 'ORCA TERMINATED NORMALLY' job.log
sha256sum geom.xyz job.inp job.log > OUTPUT_SHA256SUMS

search_screen/batch_1.sbatch.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=extra_xtb
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --array=0-2%1
#SBATCH --partition=hpxg
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%A_%a.out
set -euo pipefail
cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
# A prepared HOLD package must fail before any computation even if submitted manually.
grep -q '"submission_gate": "OPEN"' manifest.json
sha256sum -c PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS
test "${SLURM_NTASKS}" = 4
task=$(sed -n "$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID + 1))p" batch_1.txt)
test -n "$task"
source "$HOME/project/soft/xtb/env.sh"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$task"
group_root="$PWD"
while IFS= read -r seed; do
 cd "$group_root/$seed"
 sha256sum -c inputs.sha256
 mkdir -p attempts
 run_dir="attempts/${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}_${SLURM_RESTART_COUNT:-0}"
 mkdir "$run_dir"
 cp geom.xyz job.inp "$run_dir/"
 cd "$run_dir"
 set +e
 timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 480s "$HOME/project/soft/xtb/bin/xtb" geom.xyz --input job.inp --gfn 2 --opt tight > xtbopt.log 2> xtb.stderr
 rc=$?
 set -e
 printf '%s\n' "$rc" > return_code.txt
 if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -f .xtboptok ] && [ -s xtbopt.xyz ]; then
  printf 'screening_optimization_complete_scientific_qc_pending\n' > status.txt
 else
  printf 'failed_or_incomplete_no_retry\n' > status.txt
 fi
 sha256sum geom.xyz job.inp xtbopt.log xtb.stderr > OUTPUT_SHA256SUMS
done < "$group_root/seeds.txt"

thermal/batch_1.sbatch.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=extra_thermal
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --array=0-2%1
#SBATCH --partition=hpxg
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%A_%a.out
set -euo pipefail
cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
# A prepared HOLD package must fail before any computation even if submitted manually.
grep -q '"submission_gate": "OPEN"' manifest.json
sha256sum -c PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS
test "${SLURM_NTASKS}" = 4
task=$(sed -n "$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID + 1))p" batch_1.txt)
test -n "$task"
module load openmpi/5.0
source "$HOME/project/soft/orca/env.sh"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$task"
sha256sum -c inputs.sha256
mkdir -p attempts
run_dir="attempts/${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}_${SLURM_RESTART_COUNT:-0}"
mkdir "$run_dir"
cp geom.xyz job.inp "$run_dir/"
cd "$run_dir"
mkdir mpi_tmp
export TMPDIR="$PWD/mpi_tmp"
export PRTE_MCA_prte_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR" PMIX_MCA_pmix_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR"
"$ORCA_DIR/orca" job.inp > job.log 2> job.stderr
grep -q 'ORCA TERMINATED NORMALLY' job.log
sha256sum geom.xyz job.inp job.log > OUTPUT_SHA256SUMS
